_head: Phase 1's measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt at capture scale 2.2417 (882x1910 for 393.45x851.6), so run with --pt 2.2417; --against wants scratch/feed/mine, which scratch/feed/render.py fills with the eight boards shot at --scale 3 --crop-phone and resized to the captures' own pixel size. Probe and render share a basename (f1..f8), so no probe needs a 'mine'. Almost every surface here is white ink over moving video, so a sample takes --only ink with --bright and a bbox takes --bright rather than --dark; the two exceptions are the Repost pill, which is dark ink on white, and the flat fills (tab bar, pill, pin plate, accent badge) which sample --only flat; the resting progress line is too thin for even that and takes --only all. Anything set in a dimmed ink -- 'Following', an inactive tab, the scrub readout's separator -- needs its own lower threshold, or the probe finds a sliver of the brightest stroke and calls that the box. Four tokens have no probe and cannot have one: --tf-t-time and the frame metrics w/h/status/tabbar come from templates/gen.py, not from a capture, and no probe sits above y 54 because Mobbin composites the status bar out. The radii are measured as a corner's ink box rather than a number: a rounded rect's fill reaches its own left edge r below its top edge, which is what r-pill-corner and scrub-track-box check.
